target_pattern: In Spanish questions, required verb prepositions move to the front before que, and interrogative-word questions place verb before an expressed subject.

cognitive_shift.english_trap: Copying English question order and leaving prepositions at the end.
cognitive_shift.spanish_logic: Spanish front-loads required prepositions in questions and typically uses interrogative plus verb plus subject order when a question word is present.
target_pattern_formula: preposition-front question: de or en plus que plus verb
interrogative order with expressed subject: que plus verb plus subject
yes-no questions allow both verb-subject and subject-verb orders
learn verb plus preposition as one unit: pensar en, hablar de, quejarse de, arrepentirse de, disfrazarse de

pattern_mutation.instructions: Transform each base sentence as instructed.
drills: Base: Pienso en mis vacaciones. -> turn into a question to tu.
Base: Maria se queja del ruido. -> turn into a question.
Base: Quiero hablar de la reunion. -> turn into a question to tu.
Base: Me arrepiento de mi decision. -> turn into a question to tu.
Base: Nos vamos a disfrazar de superheroes. -> turn into a question.
Base: Piensan en el proyecto. -> turn into a question.
Base: Te quejas del trafico. -> turn into a question.
Base: Hablas de tu jefe. -> turn into a question.
Base: Se arrepiente de lo que dijo. -> turn into a question about el.
Base: Se van a disfrazar de medicos. -> turn into a question about ellos.
Base: Pienso en cambiar de trabajo. -> turn into a question to usted.
Base: Nos quejamos del servicio. -> turn into a question to nosotros.

prompts: What are you thinking about? (En que piensas? vs Que piensas en?)
What is she complaining about? (De que se queja? vs Que se queja de?)
What do you want to talk about? (De que quieres hablar? vs Que quieres hablar de?)
What do you regret? (De que te arrepientes? vs Que te arrepientes de?)
What are they going to dress up as? (De que se van a disfrazar? vs Que se van a disfrazar de?)
What are you all thinking about? (En que piensan ustedes? vs Que piensan ustedes en?)
What is he talking about now? (De que habla ahora? vs Que habla de ahora?)
What are we complaining about? (De que nos quejamos? vs Que nos quejamos de?)
What do you regret saying? (De que te arrepientes de decir? vs Que te arrepientes de decir?)
What are you going to dress up as tonight? (De que te vas a disfrazar esta noche? vs Que te vas a disfrazar de esta noche?)

common_errors.mistake: Preposition left at the end of the question
common_errors.why_it_happens: Direct transfer from English question order.
common_errors.correct_spanish: Move required preposition before que at the front.
Memorize and use full verb plus preposition pattern.

common_errors.mistake: Wrong preposition chosen with known verb
common_errors.correct_spanish: Use established collocations like pensar en and hablar de.

common_errors.mistake: Que plus verb plus preposition order
common_errors.correct_spanish: Use preposition plus que plus verb.

common_errors.mistake: Reflexive pronouns dropped in question forms
common_errors.correct_spanish: Keep forms like te arrepientes and se queja.

common_errors.mistake: Verb conjugation errors while focusing on preposition
common_errors.why_it_happens: Attention split between form and meaning.

common_errors.mistake: Assuming English about always maps to de
common_errors.correct_spanish: Choose preposition by Spanish verb pattern.

common_errors.mistake: Missing de in arrepentirse de questions
common_errors.why_it_happens: English form has no explicit preposition.

common_errors.mistake: Avoiding these questions due to structural uncertainty
common_errors.correct_spanish: Reuse the same preposition-front frame with new verbs.
Automate full patterns in realistic questions.
